THE SHOWDOWN: May 1929
MAY 6 Stalin delivers his first speech to the
American Commission, recommending the
total reorganization of the CPUSA secretariat
and summoning Lovestone to Moscow.
MAY 9 Without waiting for the final draft decision.
the American Delegation issues a
super factional, anti-Party declaration.
MAY 14 (THE CLIMAX)
The Comintern draft is finalized. Eight of the ten
American delegates issue a new declaration
proclaiming the explicit thesis of non-submission
to the Presidium's decisions.
We are faced with a
unique fact, worthy of
the most serious
attention... extreme
factionalism has
driven them into the
path of
insubordination,
and hence of warfare
against the Comintern.

The Strike-Breaker Analogy
THE DEFECTORS: A
minority of ten or
twenty refuse to
submit, claiming it
conflicts with their

THE SCENARIO:
The vast majority
of workers vote to
go on strike
against capitalism.
What would you call them, dear comrades? You know that such workers
are usually called strike-breakers. Collective action is absolutely
impossible if the minority refuses to subordinate itself to the majority.
The Comintern operates on the exact same principle.

The Illusion of the 99%
99%
THE BLUFF:
Lovestone claims to speak for 99% of
the CPUSA and warns his removal will
ruin the party.
THE HISTORICAL PRECEDENT:
Zinovie and Trotsky also plaved
trumps with percentages before finding

THE REALITY CHECK:
Lovestone only held a majority because
American workers believed he was a
loyal supporter of the Comintern.
THE ULTIMATUM:
Tomorrow you will have no majority and
you will find yourselves completely
isolated if you attempt to start a fight
against the decisions of the Presidium.

THE PROGNOSIS: The 6-Point Comintern Directive
1. Approve the E.C.C.I. delegation's proposals, explicitly rejecting Foster's bid
for minority rule.
2. Publish an Open Letter to the CPUSA sharply emphasizing the complete
eradication of factionalism.
3. Condemn the Majority's actions and factional maneuvering regarding the
Pepper incident.
4. Refocus the Party entirely on day today class struggle (wages, unions,
anti-reformism).
5. Reorganize the CPUSA Secretariat with workers capable of seeing beyond
narrow factional lines.
6. THE EXILE: Lovestone and Bittleman are summoned and placed at the disposal
of the Comintern in Moscow to physically break the factional wirepulling.
